headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: history was made as The Elite vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Page contested the very first AEW World Trios Titles match, appearing on All Out, rated 9.09 ? an incredible outing. Page accidentally clocked his own Dark Order partner John Silver with a Buckshot Lariat meant for Kenny Omega, letting Omega steal the pin and crown The Elite as the first-ever AEW World Trios Champions.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Kazuchika Okada vs. Kyle Fletcher fought tooth and nail for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a good, competitive contest. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

2022 brought us this moment: a new champion was crowned for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as CM Punk vs. Jon Moxley battled it out, appearing on All Out, rated 8.23 ? a genuinely great match ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. CM Punk beat Moxley to reclaim the AEW World Title in a raucous Chicago main event, but the celebration was overshadowed by Punk's post-show media-scrum outburst, which spiraled into a real backstage brawl with The Elite.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2022, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Swerve in our Glory vs. The Acclaimed went to war, appearing on All Out, rated 9.07 ? a genuine showstealer. Swerve In Our Glory held off a hard-fought challenge from The Acclaimed, with Lee and Strickland combining for a top-rope stomp to retain the AEW World Tag Team Titles in what many called the best match on the card.

Back on this day in 2022, the AEW Women's World Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Toni Storm vs. Britt Baker vs. Hikaru Shida vs. Jamie Hayter battled it out, appearing on All Out, rated 6.74 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Toni Storm hit back-to-back Tornado DDTs on Britt Baker and Jamie Hayter before pinning Hayter to become the first-ever interim AEW Women's World Champion, after Baker and Hayter's short-lived alliance turned on itself.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Cassidy, O'Reilly & Ospreay announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.77 ? a strong outing.
